channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: From Maine to Michigan, progressive candidates scored big wins for the Democratic Party
item.description: In states like Maine and Michigan, Progressives delivered major wins that helped return Democrats to power in Washington. NPR's Elena Moore discusses what comes next.

item.title: Voters rejected Trump in the midterm elections. What's next for the GOP?
item.description: President Trump asked for voters to act like he was on the ballot. If they took that advice voters gave him a stinging repudiation of his record.

item.title: Adam Hamilton is the first Democrat since 1932 to win a U.S. Senate seat in Kansas
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Adam Hamilton, a pastor who became the first Democrat in nearly a century to win a U.S. Senate seat in Kansas.

item.title: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Vivek Ramaswamy in race to become Ohio's next governor
item.description: Democrat Amy Acton, Ohio's former health director, will be the state's next governor. Her win marks the first time in two decades that Ohioans have elected a Democrat to lead the state.
